[size=3][color=#1e84cc]•°o.O[/color][color=#00ff00] Information [/color][color=#1e84cc]O.o°•[/color][/size]

All children are going to school from Monday to Friday, except for Kara, who also looks around the archeology house in Pelican Town on Saturday and Sunday!
Leo going to school from Wednesday to Friday.
Penny has a full-time job as a teacher at school, Leah helps out at school on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Fridays.
Flor has a full-time job as a teacher at school when RSV is Installed and replaces Leah.
